written_by: hand, from the designs' meaning; never from eqy or ghdl output

designs.alu.vhd: the registered ALU of ../eqy/alu.v in VHDL-2008: y <= r and z <= (r = 0) on the rising clock, reset to y = 0 and z = 1, r = a+b, a-b, a and b, a xor b by op
designs.../eqy/gate.v: equal to alu.v on every vector (the eqy corpus's simulation oracle), so equal to alu.vhd
designs.../eqy/gate_bad.v: differs from alu.v in y and in z (the eqy corpus's oracle)

outputs_mean: per output: true when every partition EQY cuts for it is proved equivalent, false when at least one is not; EQY may cut an output into one partition or one per bit, which the meaning does not decide
lowering: SimCrux lowers the [gold] ghdl line with a standalone ghdl --synth --std=08 --out=verilog and replaces it with a read_verilog of the result; the GHDL Yosys plugin is never loaded

alu_vhdl.why: gold-nomatch r cuts nothing inside the ALU, so the partitions run from the inputs to the registered outputs y and z, and the VHDL gold equals the correct netlist on both.

alu_vhdl_bad.why: The mutant's flipped gate lies in the cone of r, which feeds y and z, and the oracle shows both differ, so at least one partition of y and one of z are not equivalent.
